pre_ipo_investors: none disclosed for the H-share offering: issuer is already A-share listed (ChiNext, June 2015); 2011 introduction of institutional investors (Oriental Fortune, Guoke Ruihua, Huizhou Kaichuang, Jiaxing Shidai, Ningbo Fenghai) pre-dated the A-share IPO and is not presented as a Pre-IPO investment; later A-share private placements to independent third parties
board_roster_reviewed: Nine directors: Chen Tao (Chairman, ED, controlling shareholder), Zhao Qixiang (ED/president), Chen Yong (ED, brother of Chen Tao), Wang Haiyan (ED/employee rep), Liu Chunlan (NED, spouse of Chen Tao and member of Largest Group of Shareholders), Xie Lanjun (INED, lawyer), Xie Lingmin (INED, academic), Zhang Jihai (INED, academic), Wong Ting Chung (INED, textile/business leader). Full biographies read (pp.174-177 PDF); none links to an institutional/pre-IPO investor.
rights_and_timing: No pre-IPO investment section exists. Waiver text states none of the Existing Minority Shareholders (A-share holders <5%) has the right to appoint any Directors or other special rights; only holders above 5% are the controlling Chen Tao group. No observer right or nomination right disclosed. Caveat: this is an A+H issuer and the prospectus never literally states 'no Pre-IPO investors'; the 0 rests on the waiver statement plus the substantial-shareholder table plus the director biographies.
